holidays.name: National Sausage Pizza Day
holidays.description: A day for pizza lovers to honor the savory, spicy, meaty slice. Order a pie loaded with Italian sausage crumbles, and don't skimp on the cheese.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial food observance of unclear origin, celebrated each year on October 11.
holidays.funFact: Sausage is one of the most popular pizza toppings in the U.S., where it consistently ranks among the top choices, right behind pepperoni.

holidays.name: National Food Truck Day
holidays.description: A salute to the kitchens on wheels that have turned street food into a gourmet adventure. Track down your local truck and treat yourself to tacos, lobster rolls, or something fried and wonderful.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin that celebrates the mobile food industry and the cooks who run it.
holidays.funFact: Food trucks trace back to the chuck wagon, which Charles Goodnight created in 1866 to feed cowboys on cattle drives.

holidays.name: National It's My Party Day
holidays.description: A day to throw yourself a party for no reason at all. Invite friends, put on the music, and make yourself the guest of honor.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin that encourages everyone to celebrate being themselves.
holidays.funFact: The day's name echoes the 1963 Lesley Gore hit 'It's My Party', which reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100.
